# AgentDeck source provenance

The files `aquarium.py`, `fireplace.py`, `scenes.py`, `games.py`, `clock.py`,
`i18n.py`, and `sfx.py` are copied from
[jakeparkcolde/agentdeck](https://github.com/jakeparkcolde/agentdeck), commit
`5a8ae81c62a44e6c62b0f31e577f0af94b6dca8a`.

They are distributed under the MIT License in [LICENSE](LICENSE). The
StreamDock workers adapt their output to the 293S; no upstream source files
are modified. AgentDeck's D200-specific USB driver is not used.
